title: Perfect Day in Barcelona
text: From start to finish David was exceptional.   He accommodated all aspects of the day.  The lunch he chose was wonderful.   The sites were some we hadn’t seen before and his knowledge of the city is unmatched.  The van and driver were excellent.   If you are coming to Barcelona for a day, look no further than David for your excursion!
author: Wanderer821399

title: Best First Day!
text: Loved this tour! David organized a Mercedes van with a driver while he explained everything to us in & out of car. In depth description of Sagrada Familia. Highly Recommend
author: TravelingAlisa

title: Fantastic Tours
text:

Tanja and David were both fantastic at guiding us around and showing us so much that Barcelona has to offer. The additional information that they each shared was geared not just to adults but to my two boys as well. They both knew exactly what we all would want to see and know.

title: Tight schedule? Guiding Barcelona is your solution.
text:
I have traveled to Barcelona for business and pleasure about a half dozen times, but this was my first (Mar 2022) since the pandemic. I yearned to revisit many of my favorite places, however, business constraints left me little time – about 4 hours.
Working with David Chacón of Guiding Barcelona, we designed a private tour, which included the Gothic Quarter, Picasso Museum, Olympic Ring on Montjuïc Hill, and Sagrada Familia. During the planning stages, David was always accessible and accommodating.

text: This was the second time we had David Chacon give us a tour.  In the fall of 2018 he guided us through Segrada Familia as well as Park Gruell.
